def handle_reply(self, message):
        """
        Handles a reply from the client
        """
        if message["type"] == "http.response.start":
            # Start the response with the given status code
            if self._response_started:
                logger.error("Received http.response.start after response already started")
                return
        
            self.setResponseCode(message["status"])
        
            # Add headers
            for name, value in message.get("headers", []):
                self.responseHeaders.addRawHeader(name, value)
        
            self._response_started = True
    
        elif message["type"] == "http.response.body":
            # Write the body and possibly finish the response
            if not self._response_started:
                logger.error("Received http.response.body before http.response.start")
                self.basic_error(500, b"Internal Server Error", "Response body sent before response start.")
                return
        
            # Write the body
            body = message.get("body", b"")
            if body:
                self.write(body)
        
            # End if there's no more content
            if not message.get("more_body", False):
                self.finish()
